scope: Complete source files for the ten current redraw cards; complete named archives and supplemental collections where accessible. Source-level completeness does not mean all raw microscopy for a paper is public.

scope_notes.chhabra-2026: Complete pinned author repository, including all published intensity/phase TIFFs. Original microscope stacks were not located. The range viewer uses the selected 27°C sample.
scope_notes.lauschke-2013: All seven published supplementary movies are archived. The current kymograph uses every frame of Video 5; raw microscopy stacks are not supplied here.
scope_notes.sonnen-2018: All three published supplementary movies are archived; the current kymograph uses all 155 frames of Movie S2.
scope_notes.delaune-2012: The complete 24-frame Movie S1 used here and Movie S2 are archived. The separate S3 attachment remains unavailable.
scope_notes.masamizu-2006: The complete 45-frame Movie 2 used here and Movie 1 are archived. The separate Movie 3 attachment remains unavailable.
scope_notes.yaman-2023: Complete author v1.0 code/data archive and all 172 time points of the example matrix are saved. This example does not identify its exact sample/channel; original time-lapse stacks are not included.
scope_notes.rohde-2024: Complete pinned processed-data repository, all published track CSVs, calibration XML and ROIs are saved. The large separate EPFL raw-image collection has not been downloaded.
scope_notes.sanaki-2022: All five supplementary movies, source tables and the entire 362-frame Movie 4 are archived. The full-range replot uses an expanded ROI.
scope_notes.miao-2023: Complete 1.87 GB author data archive, all twelve supplementary movies, source tables and analysis code are saved. The Somitoid movie is composite colour; the Segmentoid viewer uses author-processed matrices.
scope_notes.jiang-2000: Both supplementary cell-movement movies are saved; they are not clock-gene reporter movies.

displayed_coverage.note: All 119 time points in the selected author intensity matrix are used; this does not mean all samples in the paper.
All 61 frames of the selected Video 5 are used, sampled within the specified ROI rather than across every pixel of the image.
All 155 frames of the selected Movie S2 are used; times come from the frame overlays.
All 24 frames of the selected Movie S1 are used, with a fixed sampling strip and no tissue tracking.
All 172 time points in the selected author example matrix are used; the corresponding source movie is not identified.

The acquisition axis has 300 positions. The selected PSM4 cohort has measurements at indices 10–207 and 209–220: 210 time points. Index 208 is missing. All time positions are retained; source-movie frames were not discarded.

The current web figure uses only the first 99 of 362 source frames (indices 0–98, 0–16 h 20 min). This was an earlier analysis subset, not the end of the source video; the source video continues beyond it.
The first 52 of 195 source frames (indices 0–51) span differentiation times 50.5–63.913 h. The cutoff near 64 h was an analysis choice to reduce MESP2 mixing, not an author-prescribed cutoff.
The card uses all 150 of 150 time points in the selected WT matrix. The knockout comparison in the details uses all 139 of 139 time points in its separate matrix.
All 45 of 45 frames in the selected Movie 2 are used. The biological sampling interval is unverified, so the axis remains frame index.
